description.hook: Tarzan has found Jane. Finding their way back to each other will be harder.
paragraphs: Jane Porter has made a place for herself in the twenty-sixth century. She has useful work, people who depend on her, and feelings for Rian Vale that cannot be dismissed because the man she loved in Africa has arrived.

Tarzan has crossed time deliberately. What he finds is a woman whose life has continued without him, in a city that already knows his name. Beyond Baltimore’s managed boundaries lies country he wants to understand—and dangers his old knowledge cannot always answer.
As Jane’s work takes her farther into that country, Tarzan’s example begins attracting attention of its own. People see a promise in him. Some hear only what they want to hear.
An intimate speculative adventure about reunion, competing loyalties, and the difficult discoveries that begin when love survives an impossible distance.
